  #define __icmp6_h

/*********************************************************************/
/* Header files                                                      */
/*********************************************************************/
#include <inttypes.h>
#include <netinet/in.h>
#include <string.h>


/*********************************************************************/
/* Macros to denote ICMP6 Type and Code Values                       */
/*********************************************************************/

#define ICMP6_DST_UNREACH             1
#define ICMP6_PACKET_TOO_BIG          2
#define ICMP6_TIME_EXCEEDED           3
#define ICMP6_PARAM_PROB              4

#define ICMP6_INFOMSG_MASK         0x80    /* all informational messages */

#define ICMP6_ECHO_REQUEST          128
#define ICMP6_ECHO_REPLY            129

#define ICMP6_DST_UNREACH_NOROUTE     0 /* no route to destination */
#define ICMP6_DST_UNREACH_ADMIN       1 /* communication with */
                                        /* destination */
                                        /* admin. prohibited */

#define ICMP6_DST_UNREACH_BEYONDSCOPE 2 /* beyond scope of source address */
#define ICMP6_DST_UNREACH_ADDR        3 /* address unreachable */
#define ICMP6_DST_UNREACH_NOPORT      4 /* bad port */

#define ICMP6_TIME_EXCEED_TRANSIT     0 /* Hop Limit == 0 in transit */
#define ICMP6_TIME_EXCEED_REASSEMBLY  1 /* Reassembly time out */

#define ICMP6_PARAMPROB_HEADER        0 /* erroneous header field */
#define ICMP6_PARAMPROB_NEXTHEADER    1 /* unrecognized Next Header */
#define ICMP6_PARAMPROB_OPTION        2 /* unrecognized IPv6 option */

/*********************************************************************/
/* Macros to denote IPv6 Multicast Listener Discovery Message Types  */
/*********************************************************************/
#define MLD_LISTENER_QUERY          130                      /* @A1A */
#define MLD_LISTENER_REPORT         131                      /* @A1A */
#define MLD_LISTENER_REDUCTION      132                      /* @A1A */

/*********************************************************************/
/* Macros to denote IPv6 Neighbor Discovery ICMP Message Types       */
/*********************************************************************/
#define ND_ROUTER_SOLICIT           133
#define ND_ROUTER_ADVERT            134
#define ND_NEIGHBOR_SOLICIT         135
#define ND_NEIGHBOR_ADVERT          136
#define ND_REDIRECT                 137

/*********************************************************************/
/* Macros to denote IPv6 Router Renumbering Message Types            */
/*********************************************************************/
#define ICMP6_ROUTER_RENUMBERING    138 /* router renumbering   @A1A */

/*********************************************************************/
/* Structures                                                        */
/*********************************************************************/

struct icmp6_hdr {
  uint8_t     icmp6_type;   /* type field */
  uint8_t     icmp6_code;   /* code field */
  uint16_t    icmp6_cksum;  /* checksum field */
  union {
    uint32_t  icmp6_un_data32[1]; /* type-specific field */
    uint16_t  icmp6_un_data16[2]; /* type-specific field */
    uint8_t   icmp6_un_data8[4];  /* type-specific field */
  } icmp6_dataun;
};

#define icmp6_data32    icmp6_dataun.icmp6_un_data32
#define icmp6_data16    icmp6_dataun.icmp6_un_data16
#define icmp6_data8     icmp6_dataun.icmp6_un_data8
#define icmp6_pptr      icmp6_data32[0]  /* parameter prob */
#define icmp6_mtu       icmp6_data32[0]  /* packet too big */
#define icmp6_id        icmp6_data16[0]  /* echo request/reply id  */
#define icmp6_seq       icmp6_data16[1]  /* echo request/reply seq */
#define icmp6_maxdelay  icmp6_data16[0]  /* mcast group membership */

struct nd_router_solicit {     /* router solicitation */
  struct icmp6_hdr  nd_rs_hdr;
    /* could be followed by options */
};

#define nd_rs_type               nd_rs_hdr.icmp6_type
#define nd_rs_code               nd_rs_hdr.icmp6_code
#define nd_rs_cksum              nd_rs_hdr.icmp6_cksum
#define nd_rs_reserved           nd_rs_hdr.icmp6_data32[0]

struct nd_router_advert {      /* router advertisement */
  struct icmp6_hdr  nd_ra_hdr;
  uint32_t   nd_ra_reachable;   /* reachable time */
  uint32_t   nd_ra_retransmit;  /* retransmit timer */
    /* could be followed by options */
};

#define nd_ra_type               nd_ra_hdr.icmp6_type
#define nd_ra_code               nd_ra_hdr.icmp6_code
#define nd_ra_cksum              nd_ra_hdr.icmp6_cksum
#define nd_ra_curhoplimit        nd_ra_hdr.icmp6_data8[0]
#define nd_ra_flags_reserved     nd_ra_hdr.icmp6_data8[1]
#define ND_RA_FLAG_MANAGED       0x80
#define ND_RA_FLAG_OTHER         0x40
#define ND_RA_FLAG_HOME_AGENT    0x20
#define ND_RA_FLAG_PREFERENCE    0x18                         /* @A0A*/
#define ND_RA_FLAG_PROXY         0x04                         /* @A3A*/
#define nd_ra_router_lifetime    nd_ra_hdr.icmp6_data16[1]

/* Router Advert Preference values                                   */
#define ND_RA_PREFERENCE_LOW     0x18 /* '11'b                   @A0A*/
#define ND_RA_PREFERENCE_MEDIUM  0x00 /* '00'b                   @A0A*/
#define ND_RA_PREFERENCE_HIGH    0x08 /* '01'b                   @A0A*/

struct nd_neighbor_solicit {   /* neighbor solicitation */
  struct icmp6_hdr  nd_ns_hdr;
  struct in6_addr   nd_ns_target; /* target address */
   /* could be followed by options */
};

#define nd_ns_type               nd_ns_hdr.icmp6_type
#define nd_ns_code               nd_ns_hdr.icmp6_code
#define nd_ns_cksum              nd_ns_hdr.icmp6_cksum
#define nd_ns_reserved           nd_ns_hdr.icmp6_data32[0]

struct nd_neighbor_advert {    /* neighbor advertisement */
  struct icmp6_hdr  nd_na_hdr;
  struct in6_addr   nd_na_target; /* target address */
    /* could be followed by options */
};

#define nd_na_type               nd_na_hdr.icmp6_type
#define nd_na_code               nd_na_hdr.icmp6_code
#define nd_na_cksum              nd_na_hdr.icmp6_cksum
#define nd_na_flags_reserved     nd_na_hdr.icmp6_data32[0]
#define ND_NA_FLAG_ROUTER        0x80000000
#define ND_NA_FLAG_SOLICITED     0x40000000
#define ND_NA_FLAG_OVERRIDE      0x20000000

struct nd_redirect {           /* redirect */
  struct icmp6_hdr  nd_rd_hdr;
  struct in6_addr   nd_rd_target; /* target address */
  struct in6_addr   nd_rd_dst;    /* destination address */
    /* could be followed by options */
};

#define nd_rd_type               nd_rd_hdr.icmp6_type
#define nd_rd_code               nd_rd_hdr.icmp6_code
#define nd_rd_cksum              nd_rd_hdr.icmp6_cksum
#define nd_rd_reserved           nd_rd_hdr.icmp6_data32[0]

struct nd_opt_hdr {            /* Neighbor discovery option header */
  uint8_t  nd_opt_type;
  uint8_t  nd_opt_len;        /* in units of 8 octets */
    /* followed by option specific data */
};

#define  ND_OPT_SOURCE_LINKADDR       1
#define  ND_OPT_TARGET_LINKADDR       2
#define  ND_OPT_PREFIX_INFORMATION    3
#define  ND_OPT_REDIRECTED_HEADER     4
#define  ND_OPT_MTU                   5
#define  ND_OPT_ADVINTERVAL           7
#define  ND_OPT_HOMEAGENT_INFO        8
#define  ND_OPT_ADV_INTERVAL          ND_OPT_ADVINTERVAL      /* @A2A*/
#define  ND_OPT_HA_INFORMATION        ND_OPT_HOMEAGENT_INFO   /* @A2A*/
#define  ND_OPT_ROUTE_INFORMATION     24                      /* @A0A*/

struct nd_opt_prefix_info {    /* prefix information */
  uint8_t   nd_opt_pi_type;
  uint8_t   nd_opt_pi_len;
  uint8_t   nd_opt_pi_prefix_len;
  uint8_t   nd_opt_pi_flags_reserved;
  uint32_t  nd_opt_pi_valid_time;
  uint32_t  nd_opt_pi_preferred_time;
  uint32_t  nd_opt_pi_reserved2;
  struct in6_addr  nd_opt_pi_prefix;
};

#define ND_OPT_PI_FLAG_ONLINK        0x80
#define ND_OPT_PI_FLAG_AUTO          0x40
#define ND_OPT_PI_FLAG_ROUTER        0x20    /* Added my Mobile IPv6 */
#define ND_OPT_PI_FLAG_SITEPREF      0x10    /* XXX sitelen is valid */

struct nd_opt_rd_hdr {         /* redirected header */
  uint8_t   nd_opt_rh_type;
  uint8_t   nd_opt_rh_len;
  uint16_t  nd_opt_rh_reserved1;
  uint32_t  nd_opt_rh_reserved2;
    /* followed by IP header and data */
};

struct nd_opt_mtu {            /* MTU option */
  uint8_t   nd_opt_mtu_type;
  uint8_t   nd_opt_mtu_len;
  uint16_t  nd_opt_mtu_reserved;
  uint32_t  nd_opt_mtu_mtu;
};

struct nd_opt_advinterval {    /* Advertisement Interval */
  uint8_t   nd_opt_adv_type;
  uint8_t   nd_opt_adv_len;
  uint16_t  nd_opt_adv_reserved;
  uint32_t  nd_opt_adv_interval; /* In milliseconds */
};

struct nd_opt_adv_interval {    /* Advertisement Interval        @A2A*/
  uint8_t   nd_opt_ai_type;                                   /* @A2A*/
  uint8_t   nd_opt_ai_len;                                    /* @A2A*/
  uint16_t  nd_opt_ai_reserved;                               /* @A2A*/
  uint32_t  nd_opt_ai_interval; /* In milliseconds */         /* @A2A*/
};                                                            /* @A2A*/

struct nd_opt_homeagent_info { /* Home Agent info */
  uint8_t   nd_opt_hai_type;
  uint8_t   nd_opt_hai_len;
  uint16_t  nd_opt_hai_reserved;
  uint16_t  nd_opt_hai_preference;                            /* @A2C*/
  uint16_t  nd_opt_hai_lifetime;
};

struct nd_opt_route_info {          /* route information         @A0A*/
  uint8_t   nd_opt_ri_type;
  uint8_t   nd_opt_ri_len;
  uint8_t   nd_opt_ri_prefix_len;
  uint8_t   nd_opt_ri_flags_reserved;
  uint32_t  nd_opt_ri_route_lifetime;
};

#define ND_OPT_RI_FLAG_PREFERENCE    0x18                     /* @A0A*/
#define ND_OPT_RI_PREFERENCE_LOW       0x18 /* '11'b             @A0A*/
#define ND_OPT_RI_PREFERENCE_MEDIUM    0x00 /* '00'b             @A0A*/
#define ND_OPT_RI_PREFERENCE_HIGH      0x08 /* '01'b             @A0A*/

/* ICMPv6 Type Filtering */
struct icmp6_filter {
  uint32_t  icmp6_filt[8];  /* 8*32 = 256 bits */
};

#define ICMP6_FILTER_WILLPASS(type, filterp) \
  ((((filterp)->icmp6_filt[(type) >> 5]) & (1 << ((type) & 31))) != 0)
#define ICMP6_FILTER_WILLBLOCK(type, filterp) \
  ((((filterp)->icmp6_filt[(type) >> 5]) & (1 << ((type) & 31))) == 0)
#define ICMP6_FILTER_SETPASS(type, filterp) \
  ((((filterp)->icmp6_filt[(type) >> 5]) |=  (1 << ((type) & 31))))
#define ICMP6_FILTER_SETBLOCK(type, filterp) \
  ((((filterp)->icmp6_filt[(type) >> 5]) &= ~(1 << ((type) & 31))))
#define ICMP6_FILTER_SETPASSALL(filterp) \
  memset((filterp), 0xFF, sizeof(struct icmp6_filter))
#define ICMP6_FILTER_SETBLOCKALL(filterp) \
  memset((filterp), 0, sizeof(struct icmp6_filter))

/*********************************************************************/
/* IPv6 Multicast Listener Discovery                                 */
/*********************************************************************/
struct mld_hdr {                                             /* @A1A */
  struct icmp6_hdr  mld_icmp6_hdr;                           /* @A1A */
  struct in6_addr   mld_addr; /* multicast address              @A1A */
};                                                           /* @A1A */

#define mld_type     mld_icmp6_hdr.icmp6_type                /* @A1A */
#define mld_code     mld_icmp6_hdr.icmp6_code                /* @A1A */
#define mld_cksum    mld_icmp6_hdr.icmp6_cksum               /* @A1A */
#define mld_maxdelay mld_icmp6_hdr.icmp6_data16[0]           /* @A1A */
#define mld_reserved mld_icmp6_hdr.icmp6_data16[1]           /* @A1A */


/*********************************************************************/
/* IPv6 Router Renumbering                                           */
/*********************************************************************/
struct icmp6_router_renum {   /* router renumbering header      @A1A */
  struct icmp6_hdr  rr_hdr;                                  /* @A1A */
  uint8_t           rr_segnum;                               /* @A1A */
  uint8_t           rr_flags;                                /* @A1A */
  uint16_t          rr_maxdelay;                             /* @A1A */
  uint32_t          rr_reserved;                             /* @A1A */
};                                                           /* @A1A */

#define rr_type                  rr_hdr.icmp6_type           /* @A1A */
#define rr_code                  rr_hdr.icmp6_code           /* @A1A */
#define rr_cksum                 rr_hdr.icmp6_cksum          /* @A1A */
#define rr_seqnum                rr_hdr.icmp6_data32[0]      /* @A1A */

/* Router renumbering flags */
#define ICMP6_RR_FLAGS_TEST        0x80                      /* @A1A */
#define ICMP6_RR_FLAGS_REQRESULT   0x40                      /* @A1A */
#define ICMP6_RR_FLAGS_FORCEAPPLY  0x20                      /* @A1A */
#define ICMP6_RR_FLAGS_SPECSITE    0x10                      /* @A1A */
#define ICMP6_RR_FLAGS_PREVDONE    0x08                      /* @A1A */

struct rr_pco_match {    /* match prefix part                   @A1A */
  uint8_t          rpm_code;                                 /* @A1A */
  uint8_t          rpm_len;                                  /* @A1A */
  uint8_t          rpm_ordinal;                              /* @A1A */
  uint8_t          rpm_matchlen;                             /* @A1A */
  uint8_t          rpm_minlen;                               /* @A1A */
  uint8_t          rpm_maxlen;                               /* @A1A */
  uint16_t         rpm_reserved;                             /* @A1A */
  struct in6_addr  rpm_prefix;                               /* @A1A */
};                                                           /* @A1A */

/* PCO code values */
#define RPM_PCO_ADD              1                           /* @A1A */
#define RPM_PCO_CHANGE           2                           /* @A1A */
#define RPM_PCO_SETGLOBAL        3                           /* @A1A */

struct rr_pco_use {    /* use prefix part                       @A1A */
  uint8_t          rpu_uselen;                               /* @A1A */
  uint8_t          rpu_keeplen;                              /* @A1A */
  uint8_t          rpu_ramask;                               /* @A1A */
  uint8_t          rpu_raflags;                              /* @A1A */
  uint32_t         rpu_vltime;                               /* @A1A */
  uint32_t         rpu_pltime;                               /* @A1A */
  uint32_t         rpu_flags;                                /* @A1A */
  struct in6_addr  rpu_prefix;                               /* @A1A */
};                                                           /* @A1A */

#define ICMP6_RR_PCOUSE_RAFLAGS_ONLINK   0x20                /* @A1A */
#define ICMP6_RR_PCOUSE_RAFLAGS_AUTO     0x10                /* @A1A */

#define ICMP6_RR_PCOUSE_FLAGS_DECRVLTIME 0x80000000          /* @A1A */
#define ICMP6_RR_PCOUSE_FLAGS_DECRPLTIME 0x40000000          /* @A1A */

struct rr_result {    /* router renumbering result message      @A1A */
  uint16_t         rrr_flags;                                /* @A1A */
  uint8_t          rrr_ordinal;                              /* @A1A */
  uint8_t          rrr_matchedlen;                           /* @A1A */
  uint32_t         rrr_ifid;                                 /* @A1A */
  struct in6_addr  rrr_prefix;                               /* @A1A */
};                                                           /* @A1A */

#define ICMP6_RR_RESULT_FLAGS_OOB        0x0002              /* @A1A */
#define ICMP6_RR_RESULT_FLAGS_FORBIDDEN  0x0001              /* @A1A */

#endif  /* __icmp6_h */
